lines: You would resist us? Even though you're guests, we won't overlook this.
These two both seem to have some good life force. Let's make them into a night shift snack♪
Dammit, what the hell!? These guys're stronger than the ones before!
Succubi and Incubi come in all types! From the capable ones to the useless little devils!
We repelled and dodged the demons' attacks even while carrying on the conversation.
Dammit, there's only so much I can do with my bare hands. If only I could use a gun...
But the demons also stopped moving. They seemed to have been surprised that we, who they'd thought had simply wandered in, had dodged their attacks.
They don't seem to be just lost children. Send for it, head maid.
Huh, "it"!? But will it really be alright...?
To be honest, it worries me, but if it's enough to toss out swimmers like these two...
I exchanged looks with Aina, then slipped past to the side of the demons and immediately dashed for the interior.
Hello, headquarters? An intruder has appeared in the annex.
An unarmed pair, a man and a woman. Get it ready...
The sound of footsteps busily moving around and demons' voices could be heard through the door.
(Hey, Fuma, scoot a little that way.)
(Shhh, I said don't move. We'll be found if we make a sound.)
Making sure that any signs of their presence were long gone, we crawled out from behind the desk and took a breath.
This was one of the many bedrooms. We'd been hiding there and avoiding the demons.
Not good... The sun's started to set. You okay, Aina? Your face is red.
Aina's skin had become hot and damp, to the extent that I could feel it just being at her side.
(I guess you get in the habit of paying attention to the condition of those around you when you're acting as unit leader.)
I've kinda been runnin' outta breath fast and my body's been burnin' up for a while now...
Maybe the demon qi started spreading. Could be because we went all out dressed like this...
With the words, "like this," I shifted my focus to see that Aina's far-too-small swimsuit had been disheveled by the battle,
and her fair-skinned breasts were tinged slightly pinkish, rising and falling in time with her breathing.
(Er, no-no! This isn't the time for that! The demon qi probably started spreading through me too...)
Half calling out to myself, I put my hand on Aina's shoulder, and her body jolted.
Aiee!? Don't just touch me all of a sudden!
S-Sorry! Anyway, seems like we'd better hurry for real now.
What I mean is... if the demon qi fully spreads, we'll get so aroused that we won't be able to think straight.
Let's get the medicine before that happens, no matter what!
Yeah, no way I'll just get deliciously devoured by those demons!
We got up and rushed out into the hallway again to break the indulgent atmosphere that had started to spread.
